name: Can I paint over repaired wood trim, and will the repair be visible?

mainEntity.name: Can I paint over repaired wood trim, and will the repair be visible?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can paint over repaired wood trim, and a high-quality repair should be nearly invisible once painted. The key is thorough preparation: the repaired area must be completely smooth, flush with the surrounding trim, and properly primed. Any imperfections, such as ridges or depressions from filler, will likely show through the paint. As a Preparation tip, ensure the repaired surface is sanded to a fine grit and primed with a good quality primer to create an even surface for the topcoat, maximizing the chances of an undetectable repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can paint over repaired trim, and it should be invisible if properly prepared. Ensure the repaired area is smooth, flush, and well-primed before painting to prevent imperfections from showing.
